models.name: todo_app_guests
models.description: Temporary guest identity records for unauthenticated access. This table stores device-related identifiers used to distinguish guest sessions without requiring email/password credentials, and it supports soft deletion for privacy and lifecycle management. Sessions for guests reference this identity from the guest session table {@link todo_app_guest_sessions}.

plainFields.name: device_identifier
plainFields.description: Stable identifier of the device or client used to associate multiple guest sessions with the same guest identity.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this guest identity was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When this guest identity was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. When set, this guest identity is treated as deleted and should no longer be used for new sessions.

models.name: todo_app_guest_sessions
models.description:
Stores login/session connection records for unauthenticated guest access in order to audit activity and manage guest session expiration.

Each row represents a single guest session context and is linked to exactly one guest identity ({@link todo_app_guests.id}). This table captures connection metadata (IP address and navigation context) and the session expiration timestamp. Soft deletion is supported via deleted_at.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address observed for this guest session.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Request URL (or landing href) associated with the guest session initiation.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer value observed for the request that created/used this guest session.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: When this guest session expires and should no longer be accepted.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp of the guest session record.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp of the guest session record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for this session record. Null means the session is not deleted.

models.name: todo_app_members
models.description:
Registered authenticated member accounts for the todo app.

This table stores the member's login credentials (email and password hash) and lifecycle/account status used by authentication and authorization logic. Soft deletion is supported via deleted_at.

Relationships:
- One member can have many login sessions in {@link todo_app_member_sessions}.
- One member can have many password reset attempts in {@link todo_app_member_password_resets}.
- One member can have many email verification tokens in {@link todo_app_member_email_verifications}.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address used for member login and identity lookups.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password credential for the member account (never store plaintext passwords).

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Account lifecycle status used to control whether the member can authenticate and access resources. Stored as a string category value defined by the domain rules.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp for the member account.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp for the member account.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. When set, the member is considered deleted and should not authenticate.

models.name: todo_app_member_sessions
models.description: JWT-based login session records for authenticated members. Each record ties a member's active session to connection context (IP and referrer) and stores session expiration time for security auditing and access control. This table is created and managed by the authentication/session lifecycle flow, not by domain operations.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address captured at session creation time.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Request URL (or origin) associated with the session creation event.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer header captured at session creation time.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp. Used to invalidate the session after its lifetime.

models._comment: Indices follow the session pattern composite index on (member_id, created_at).

models.name: todo_app_member_password_resets
models.description: Stores password reset tokens for member accounts. Each record represents a token issued for account recovery, including when it expires and whether it has been used so the token can be treated as single-use. Tokens belong to exactly one member account via {@link todo_app_members.id}.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_member_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged member account for which this password reset token was issued. {@link todo_app_members.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Opaque password reset token value used by the client to authorize a password change. Treat as a secret credential.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Expiration timestamp after which the token must be rejected.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: When the token was successfully used. Null means the token is still unused.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp of the password reset token record.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp of the password reset token record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp for administrative or cleanup purposes.

models.name: todo_app_member_email_verifications
models.description: Email verification token records for member accounts. These tokens are issued during registration and other email-ownership workflows, allowing the system to confirm that the email address belongs to the authenticated member. Each record links to exactly one member and is evaluated by token value and expiration status.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Verification token value used to confirm email ownership.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Expiration timestamp after which this token is invalid.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the token was successfully used; null if unused.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Null means the record is active.

models.name: todo_app_user_profiles
models.description:
Private, non-shareable user profile data associated with exactly one owning user account.

This table stores the current profile personalization attribute (display name) that a member user can view and edit for their own experience. The profile is owned by the member account and is removed as part of the account deletion lifecycle.

All access is scoped to the owning member to prevent cross-user visibility.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Current display name personalization for the owning member user.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp of this profile record.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp of this profile record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. When set, the profile is considered deleted for business purposes.

models.name: todo_app_todo_history_entries
models.description:
Append-only audit records of each change made by a member to a specific todo. Each row represents one edit event and stores the updated values for the fields that were changed during that operation, along with the event timestamp for newest-to-oldest history retrieval.

This table is intended to be immutable from the business perspective (updates should be avoided); however it supports soft deletion via deleted_at for administrative or retention purposes.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_todo_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged todo that this history entry records changes for ({@link todo_app_todos.id}).

plainFields.name: changed_title
plainFields.description: New title value for this change event when the title was modified; null when the title was not part of the edit.

plainFields.name: changed_description
plainFields.description: New description value for this change event when the description was modified; null when the description was not part of the edit.

plainFields.name: changed_start_date
plainFields.description: New start date value for this change event when the start date was modified; null when the start date was not part of the edit.

plainFields.name: changed_due_date
plainFields.description: New due date value for this change event when the due date was modified; null when the due date was not part of the edit.

plainFields.name: changed_completion_status
plainFields.description: New completion status value for this change event when completion was modified; null when completion was not part of the edit.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this edit event occurred (used to order history from newest to oldest).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this record was last updated (should generally remain unchanged after creation).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for the history entry.

models.name: todo_app_todo_history_entry_order_indexes
models.description:
Supporting index records that enable efficient retrieval of a single todo's edit history ordered from newest to oldest.

Each row ties one {@link todo_app_todos.id} to one {@link todo_app_todo_history_entries.id} history entry and provides ordering keys used by list and pagination queries. This table does not store business text; it only supports fast lookup and ordering.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_todo_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged todo for which this history-entry index row is used ({@link todo_app_todos.id}).

foreignFields.name: todo_app_todo_history_entry_id
foreignFields.description: Referenced todo history entry that is indexed for ordered retrieval ({@link todo_app_todo_history_entries.id}).

plainFields.name: position
plainFields.description: Integer position used to represent the ordered sequence of history entries for the referenced todo (newest-first ordering).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp for this index row.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record update timestamp for this index row.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for this index row when the corresponding history ordering should no longer be considered.

models.name: todo_app_todos
models.description:
Main todo items owned by exactly one member account in a private todo app.

A todo is created with a required title and starts as incomplete by default. It can optionally carry a description plus optional planning/tracking dates (start_date and due_date). The owning user can browse todos in two business contexts: Active (part of the normal todo list) and Deleted (in the trash list). Edit history remains associated while the todo is either Active or Deleted(in trash), and is permanently removed only when the todo is permanently deleted.

This table supports privacy boundaries by scoping every todo to its owning member account via a foreign key. The title is required for both creation and editing; clearing the title is rejected at the service layer.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_member_id
foreignFields.description: Owning member account for this todo. All todo viewing and management is scoped to this member to preserve privacy boundaries.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Todo title. Required; a todo cannot exist without a title and edits cannot clear the title.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional description text for the todo. May be empty/absent while the todo still exists.

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description: Optional planning attribute representing the time the owning user indicates the task should start. Unset means no start date was provided.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: Optional tracking attribute representing the time the owning user indicates the task is due. Unset means no due date was provided.

plainFields.name: completion_status
plainFields.description: Binary completion state of the todo: true means complete, false means incomplete. New todos start as incomplete.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp of the todo used for ordering the user’s todo list. Remains the original creation time across lifecycle changes.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp for this todo record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp. When set, the record is treated as removed from the accessible set in persistence-level semantics (used for permanent deletion flows if needed).

plainFields.name: deleted_in_trash_at
plainFields.description: Lifecycle timestamp indicating the todo has been moved to Deleted (in trash). When null, the todo is treated as Active in the normal todo list; when set, it is shown in the trash list until restored or permanently deleted.

models.name: todo_app_todo_snapshots
models.description:
Point-in-time snapshots of a todo's state for audit history and recovery.

Each time a todo is changed, this table stores the denormalized fields needed to reconstruct what the todo looked like at that moment. The snapshot is linked to the owning todo record via {@link todo_app_todos.id}. Snapshots are intended to be append-only from the application perspective and support viewing edit history and restoring a todo after recovery flows.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_todo_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged todo for which this snapshot captures the point-in-time state {@link todo_app_todos.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Todo title as it was at the time this snapshot was created.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional todo description as it was at the time this snapshot was created.

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description: Optional planned start date of the todo captured in this snapshot.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: Optional due date of the todo captured in this snapshot.

plainFields.name: completion_status
plainFields.description: Todo completion status captured in this snapshot (represents whether the todo was completed or not at that time).

plainFields.name: lifecycle_deleted
plainFields.description: Whether the todo was in the deleted/trash lifecycle state at the time this snapshot was taken.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Snapshot creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Snapshot last update timestamp (typically unchanged after creation).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for the snapshot record when it is removed from active history.
